scope: Unchanged tests/jest.coverage.config.cjs collectCoverageFrom; critical services, not whole monorepo

baselineUncovered.source: throw new Error('Ollama model must be explicit');

baselineUncovered.assessment: V8 reports the finally boundary as a separate empty range. Success, invalid citations, retrieval/context/generation failure, timeout and cancellation tests execute cleanup; retained as an instrumentation gap, not excluded.

Generic-error + aborted-signal fallback is not separately reached: the bounded abort race normally produces a typed GeminiFailure first. Both cooperative and uncooperative timeout tests assert failure/lease release. No fake SDK internals added to force race ordering.
V8 finally-boundary range. Tests explicitly assert lease release on success, HTTP failures, timeouts, malformed body and persistence checkpoint failure. Still reported, not removed from denominator.

SDK endpoint allowlist denial is defensive: the official SDK is given a constant origin, API version, model and POST method. Reaching denial requires replacing/mutating SDK internals. Tests inspect the actual SDK-generated URL/method and forbid paid features; guard retained.
PostgreSQL aggregate without GROUP BY always returns one row, including an empty attempt set. DB exceptions are tested. Returning zero rows would require replacing database semantics or the query.

baselineUncovered.source: if (!previous || previous.revision >= version.revision) throw new StoreConflict('state');
if (!record) throw new Error('Missing idempotency record');
baselineUncovered.assessment: The idempotency row is inserted then locked/read in the same transaction; the unique constraint serializes competing writers. A missing row requires privileged trigger/corruption outside supported behavior. Existing tests cover concurrent reuse, conflicts and rollback.
V8 finally-boundary range, with successful, conflicting and rolled-back mutations tested against real PostgreSQL. Connection release is exercised, not excluded.
ingestion_pending_count() is an aggregate function returning one numeric row. Missing-row fallback is defensive; real 1,000-item saturation and concurrent admission tests cover capacity denial.

AJV populates errors when synchronous validation returns false. Null-error fallback requires a substituted/malformed validator implementation; request validation and response rejection already tested.

Redis EXEC can return null after a watched-key conflict; this implementation never WATCHes. No WATCH means normal EXEC returns results or throws. Real WRONGTYPE results and disconnection fail closed in tests.

Overlapping/stopped scheduler tick is reachable under timing/load. Runtime readiness/shutdown and dispatch are tested; this exact short-circuit remains a lifecycle follow-up.
Existing Ollama heartbeat unavailable branch not exercised at runtime; no automatic provider switching enabled. Offline adapter tests remain.

normalizeText caps text at 200,000 characters; 1,000-character chunks advancing 900 produce at most 223 chunks. The >256 guard is unreachable with current constants. Length limits and actual chunk overlap are tested.
